fr_html: LORD PHILLIMORE demande des renseignements sur la portée du mot „engagement”. Il voudrait savoir si ce terme comprend également les obligations involontaires.
en_html: LORD PHILLIMORE asked to be informed as to the meaning of the word “engagement” (agreement). He wished to know whether it also included involuntary obligations.
